verdict.rationale: Carta publishes a per-endpoint API reference (cap table, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, FMVs). It offers a credential-free playground that returns static but valid responses, plus a Postman guide, so examples can be run against a sandbox. None of the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive, such as an in-page "try it" console or embedded runnable snippets, so running requests appears to need external tooling like Postman. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable code samples embedded in the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
